long_video_attention.default: 256 queries per batch for eval without gradients when length exceeds 256 frames
long_video_attention.semantics: Original temporal windows, padding fallback, absolute RoPE positions and input precision; complete-sequence model forward retained
long_video_attention.scope: Local source adaptation; no weights or runtime dependency changes; real six-minute CUDA inference still requires target-machine validation

bounded_memory_adaptation.camera: Stream the original sampled RGB images into unchanged SIFT matching and pose interpolation; close readers on completion, errors and cancellation
bounded_memory_adaptation.rotary_tables: Share identical canonical FP32-angle RoPE tables within an ExMR model lifetime; retain private per-layer cache histories after any non-FP32 angle conversion, including conversion back to FP32; clear derived tables on device/dtype moves
bounded_memory_adaptation.semantics: Unchanged checkpoints, image pixels, sampling, model precision, temporal context and motion equations
bounded_memory_adaptation.validation: See docs/MEMORY_OPTIMIZATION.md in RGB MoCap for numerical equivalence and measured validation scope

compatibility: Native Windows pinned RGB MoCap runtime; bounded sequential loaders, CPU-first Low Memory body/hand loading, pre-transfer Sapiens FP16, local DINOv3 and Unicode-safe image IO retained. Public hand_boxes/model_inputs/ExMR.from_pretrained and direct model forward replace private pipeline calls. Stage-scoped model reuse, removable hooks, bounded CPU prefetch and unused final body readout omission retained. Upstream v0.1.5 axis-wise 0.03 m toe IK bound enabled. Local normalize_world switch defaults to upstream behavior; app disables it to retain its scene/camera frame. Explicit SimpleVO frame_reader callback preserves canonical-video pixels. App shared contact detection and correction are unchanged; upstream foot_contacts is not used. Runtime package pins and model weights unchanged.
